plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of the meaning, branches, relationships, and importance of Mathematics.
plan.general_objectives: Explain the concept of Mathematics, its branches, and its importance in daily life and careers.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson the student should be able to: (a) explain the meaning of Mathematics; (b) classify the branches of Mathematics; (c) state the relationship between Mathematics and other subjects; (d) explain the importance of Mathematics.
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of Mathematics.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to brainstorm on the meaning of Mathematics.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to identify the branches of Mathematics and their relationships with other subjects.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to classify branches of Mathematics and relate it to other subjects.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to discuss the importance of Mathematics in daily life and careers.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to present the importance of Mathematics in various careers.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Using questions and answers help students to summarize concepts taught.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to individually answer questions asked by the teacher.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of the number system, inequalities, and absolute value of real numbers.
plan.general_objectives: Explain the concept of numbers and classify rational, irrational, and real numbers.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson the student should be able to: (a) explain the concept of numbers; (b) classify rational and irrational numbers; (c) explain real numbers and inequalities; (d) determine the absolute value of a real number.
plan.teaching_aids: Number classification chart, number line, textbook
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to identify base ten numeration and the concept of numbers.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to classify natural numbers, whole numbers, and integers.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to define rational and irrational numbers with examples and represent them on a number line.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in pairs to classify numbers as rational or irrational and represent them on a number line.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to describe the real number system and represent inequalities.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to represent inequalities on a number line.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to calculate the absolute value of real numbers.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to individually calculate |x| for given real numbers.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of approximation techniques including rounding off and significant figures.
plan.general_objectives: Explain approximation and apply it in calculations.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: (a) explain the meaning of approximation; (b) round off numbers to given place values; (c) determine significant figures; (d) apply approximations in calculations.
plan.teaching_aids: Rounding rules chart, worked examples, textbook
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explain the meaning of approximation and show students how to round off numbers.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in pairs to round off whole numbers to given place values.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to round off decimals to a given number of decimal places and determine significant figures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to round off numbers to given significant figures and decimal places.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to apply approximations in everyday estimation and calculations.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to apply approximations in real-life estimation tasks.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of ratios and proportions and apply them in daily life.
plan.general_objectives: Explain and apply ratios and proportions in solving real-life problems.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: (a) explain and apply ratios; (b) explain and apply direct and inverse proportion.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to express quantities as ratios and simplify ratios.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to express and simplify ratios using real-life examples.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to solve real-life sharing problems using ratios and apply direct and inverse proportion.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in groups to solve ratio and proportion problems.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to apply proportions in real-life scenarios (recipes, speed/time).

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation, equations, simultaneous equations, and inequalities.
plan.general_objectives: Form and solve algebraic expressions, equations, simultaneous equations, and inequalities.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson the student should be able to: (a) form and simplify algebraic expressions; (b) form and solve algebraic equations; (c) solve linear simultaneous equations; (d) solve inequalities with one unknown.
plan.teaching_aids: Algebra worked examples, textbook, manila cards
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Use daily life examples to show how letters are used to represent objects in algebraic expressions.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to form algebraic expressions using letters.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms and solve linear equations.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in pairs to simplify expressions and solve linear equations.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to solve linear simultaneous equations using elimination and substitution methods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in pairs to solve simultaneous equations.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to solve inequalities with one unknown and represent solutions on a number line.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to individually solve inequalities and represent them on a number line.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: To write short summarized notes and assign homework.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to copy notes and work on the assignment.

plan.competence: Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry, gradient, equations of straight lines, and graphical solutions.
plan.general_objectives: Explain basic concepts of coordinate geometry and determine the equation of a straight line.
plan.specific_objectives: By the end of the lesson, the student should be able to: (a) explain basic concepts of coordinate geometry; (b) determine the gradient of a straight line; (c) determine the equation of a straight line; (d) graph linear equations and solve simultaneous equations graphically.
plan.teaching_aids: Graph papers, Cartesian plane chart, rulers, textbook
plan.remarks: The students who did not understand the lesson well will be in the remedial class. Otherwise I will proceed with the topic.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to calculate the gradient of a line and derive the equation of a straight line in the form y = mx + c.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students to calculate gradients and determine equations of straight lines.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guide students to express equations in general form ax + by + c = 0.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Students in pairs to express equations in general form.
